questions.question: Qaysi jarayon 8080 portni band qilganini qanday topasan?
questions.explanation: ss — netstat'ning zamonaviy va tezroq o'rnini bosuvchisi: -l listening, -t TCP, -n raqamli, -p jarayon (boshqa foydalanuvchi jarayoni uchun root kerak). 'address already in use' ko'pincha eski jarayon yoki TIME_WAIT (SO_REUSEADDR yechadi).

questions.question: Serverda minglab `TIME_WAIT` ulanishlar. Muammomi?
questions.explanation: tcp_tw_recycle NAT ortidagi clientlarni buzardi va Linux 4.12 da olib tashlandi. Haqiqiy belgisi: 'cannot assign requested address' (ephemeral port tugashi, ip_local_port_range). Eng yaxshi yechim — ulanishlarni qayta ishlatish.

questions.question: DNS muammosini qanday tekshirasan?
questions.explanation: dig resolv.conf'dan foydalanadi, lekin nsswitch/hosts'ni chetlab o'tadi — getent ilova bilan bir xil yo'ldan yuradi. K8s'da ndots:5 tashqi domenlar uchun ko'p ortiqcha so'rov beradi (FQDN oxiriga nuqta yoki ndots kamaytirish).

questions.question: `curl` sekin — 5 soniya kutib keyin javob beradi. Qayerda yo'qolayotganini qanday aniqlaysan?
questions.explanation: `curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{time_namelookup} %{time_connect} %{time_appconnect} %{time_starttransfer}\n' URL`. Aynan 5s — ko'pincha DNS (AAAA so'rovi javobsiz, resolver timeout 5s) yoki IPv6 ga urinib keyin IPv4 ga o'tish. Chuqurroq: tcpdump.

questions.question: `iptables`/`nftables` da DROP va REJECT farqi?
questions.explanation: Ichki tarmoqda REJECT diagnostikani osonlashtiradi va tez fail beradi; tashqi hujumchilarga DROP kam ma'lumot beradi. Debugging: `iptables -L -n -v` hisoblagichlari, `conntrack -L`; to'lgan conntrack jadvali ('nf_conntrack: table full') paketlarni tashlaydi.

questions.question: SSH serverni qanday xavfsizlashtirasan?
questions.explanation: Zamonaviy yondashuv: SSH kalitlar o'rniga qisqa muddatli sertifikatlar (Vault SSH CA, Teleport) yoki umuman SSH'siz boshqaruv (AWS SSM). Port o'zgartirish faqat log shovqinini kamaytiradi, xavfsizlik bermaydi.

questions.question: Konteyner Linux'da qanday izolyatsiya qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Konteynerlar bitta yadroni bo'lishadi — yadro zaifligi hamma konteynerga ta'sir qiladi (shuning uchun gVisor, Kata, Firecracker). Root konteyner ichida hostda ham root (user namespace ishlatilmasa) — rootless va runAsNonRoot shuning uchun muhim.

questions.question: Konteynerda Go/Java ilova CPU limiti bilan sekin ishlayapti, CPU esa limitgacha yetmayapti. Nima bo'lishi mumkin?
questions.explanation: Tekshirish: cgroup'dagi cpu.stat (nr_throttled, throttled_usec). Yechim: GOMAXPROCS'ni limitga moslash (Go 1.25+ avtomatik, oldin automaxprocs), limitni oshirish yoki CPU limitini olib tashlab faqat request qo'yish.

questions.question: Unix domain socket va TCP socket farqi?
questions.explanation: Misollar: /var/run/docker.sock (unga kirish = host'da root!), PostgreSQL /var/run/postgresql/.s.PGSQL.5432. Konteynerlar o'rtasida sidecar bilan ham ishlatiladi. `ss -xl` — ro'yxat.

questions.question: `ip` buyrug'i: IP manzil, route, interfeyslarni ko'rish. `ifconfig`/`netstat` bilan farqi?
questions.explanation: `ip a` manzillar, `ip r` route, `ip link` interfeys, `ip neigh` ARP. ifconfig/netstat/route — net-tools, eskirgan; o'rniga iproute2 (`ip`, `ss`).

questions.question: `ss -tulpn` flaglari nima? Port ochiqligini qanday tekshirasan?
questions.explanation: -t TCP, -u UDP, -l listening, -p process, -n raqamli (DNS/servis nomi yo'q). Lokal: `ss -tlnp | grep :80`; masofadan: `nc -zv host 80`, `curl -v`, `telnet`.

questions.question: `curl` kerakli flaglari: debug, header, method, timeout, TLS?
questions.explanation: -v verbose, -I faqat header, -X method, -H header, -d data, -o/-O, -L redirect, -k TLS tekshirmaslik, --resolve, -w timing, --connect-timeout/-m, -s/-S, -f.

questions.question: `dig` va `nslookup`: DNS'ni qanday tekshirasan? `/etc/hosts`, `/etc/resolv.conf`?
questions.explanation: `dig +short x.com`, `dig x.com A/AAAA/MX/CNAME`, `dig @8.8.8.8 x.com`, `dig +trace`. Resolution tartibi `/etc/nsswitch.conf` (`hosts: files dns`): avval /etc/hosts, keyin resolv.conf'dagi nameserver.

questions.question: `tcpdump` bilan trafikni qanday ushlaysan? Kerakli filtrlar.
questions.explanation: `tcpdump -i any -nn port 443`, host/net/port filtrlari, -w faylga (Wireshark'da ochish), -A/-X payload, -c count, SYN/RST flaglari bo'yicha filtr.

questions.question: Firewall: ufw, firewalld, iptables, nftables — farqi? Portni qanday ochasan?
questions.explanation: Hammasining ostida kernel netfilter. iptables — eski CLI, nftables — yangi. ufw (Ubuntu) va firewalld (RHEL) — ular ustidagi qulay frontend.

questions.question: "Servis ishlayapti, lekin tashqaridan ochilmayapti". Qatlamma-qatlam tekshir.
questions.explanation: Ichkaridan tashqariga: jarayon ishlayaptimi -> qaysi IP/portda listen (`ss -tlnp`) -> lokal `curl` -> host firewall -> cloud security group/NACL -> LB/target health -> DNS -> client tomoni.

questions.question: `ping` ishlaydi, lekin ulanish bo'lmaydi / sekin. `traceroute`, `mtr` va MTU muammosi.
questions.explanation: ping (ICMP) != TCP portiga yo'l. mtr — har hop'da loss/latency. Kichik so'rov ishlaydi, katta javob osiladi — PMTU/MTU muammosi (VPN, overlay tarmoq), ICMP bloklangan.

questions.question: SELinux / AppArmor ilovani bloklayapti. Qanday aniqlaysan va to'g'ri hal qilasan?
questions.explanation: Belgi: ruxsatlar to'g'ri, lekin "Permission denied". `getenforce`, `ausearch -m avc -ts recent`, `/var/log/audit/audit.log`. To'g'ri yechim — context/boolean/port (semanage, restorecon), `setenforce 0` emas.

questions.question: Yangi Linux serverni production'ga chiqarishdan oldin xavfsizlik checklist'i (hardening).
questions.explanation: Update + avtomatik security patch; faqat kalit bilan SSH, root login yo'q; firewall default deny; keraksiz servis/portlarni o'chirish; least privilege sudo; vaqt sinxroni; loglar markaziy; auditd; fail2ban; disk shifrlash/secret'lar; CIS benchmark bilan tekshirish (Lynis).

questions.question: auditd nima? Kim `/etc/passwd`ni o'zgartirdi yoki kim `sudo` bilan nima qildi — qanday topasan?
questions.explanation: auditd — kernel audit tizimi: syscall va fayl kirishlarini qoida bo'yicha qayd qiladi (kim, qachon, qaysi jarayon, auid — dastlabki login user). `auditctl -w fayl -p wa -k kalit`, qidirish `ausearch -k`, hisobot `aureport`.

questions.question: Ochiq portlar va servislarni tashqaridan audit qilish: `nmap` asosiy flaglari.
questions.explanation: `nmap -sT/-sS` port skan, `-p-` hamma portlar, `-sV` servis versiyasi, `-sU` UDP, `-Pn` ping'siz, `-O` OS, `--script ssl-enum-ciphers`. Faqat o'zingga tegishli yoki ruxsat berilgan tizimlarni skanerla.

questions.question: DDoS / SYN flood paytida Linux server darajasida nima qila olasan?
questions.explanation: Haqiqiy himoya — tarmoq chetida (CDN/cloud DDoS protection, upstream). Host darajasida: `tcp_syncookies`, backlog, rate limit (nftables/iptables hashlimit, nginx limit_req), conntrack sozlash, keraksiz portlarni yopish, monitoring. Aniqla: qaysi turdagi hujum (L3/L4 volumetric yoki L7).

questions.question: iptables qoidasi qo'shding va o'zingni serverdan chiqarib yubording. Bunga qanday yo'l qo'ymaslik kerak?
questions.explanation: Masofadan firewall o'zgartirishda: avval ESTABLISHED va SSH'ga ruxsat, keyin DROP; avtomatik rollback (`at`/`sleep && iptables-restore`, `netplan try`, `firewall-cmd --timeout`); konsol kirish tayyor; o'zgarishni IaC orqali va canary hostda sinash.

questions.question: Network namespace va veth: konteyner tarmog'i qanday ishlaydi (`ip netns` bilan)?
questions.explanation: Network namespace — alohida tarmoq stek (interfeys, route, iptables). veth — ikki uchli virtual kabel: bir uchi namespace ichida, ikkinchisi host'da (yoki bridge'da). Docker/K8s CNI aynan shunday qiladi.
